notes.title: Big bugfix update (1.3.3 game version)
notes.content:
The update included:
1. Fixed a critical bug in the dungeon
2. Fixed bug with stove and chocolate
3. Fixed layers of candles in the room with mirrors
4. Fixed diary behavior when the poison detector is open
5. Removed dialogues after using items in the museum

Some internal optimizations have also been done.

notes.title: The official soundtrack for Detective From The Crypt
notes.content:
The official soundtrack for Detective From The Crypt immerses the listener in the mystical world of the game. Compositions are created in trance style. Most tunes are looped and can be played for hours.

Detective From The Crypt Soundtrack is composed by BOV.

Tracklist:

1. Menu
2. Bad End
3. Bagpipe
4. Cave
5. Cemetery Melody
6. Chirch
7. Clock
8. Crypt
9. Egypt
10. Hall Fall Down
11. Hall Fall Down Organ
12. Harpsichord
13. Nock Nock
14. Sad
15. Spirits
16. Trance
17. Trance 2
18. Trance Soft Strings
19. Trance Sounds UP
20. Trance Two Floor

notes.title: Demo is available
notes.content:
We are pleased to present a demo version of the game.

In it, you can walk through the cemetery, meet its inhabitants and help some of them in solving their problems. You will meet charming Pulcheria and receive a letter from the other world.

[previewyoutube=ePEdyJInCkw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Scientific office for laboratory analyzes.
notes.content:
Scientific office for laboratory analyzes of the found substances. Now you can check various substances for the content of poisons. On the basis of this, conclusions are drawn and hypotheses are built regarding what happened to the main character and her family.

notes.title: Development news: magic candle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38143999/2a7a2aa8fbd8d4982e1c831187385590975be205.jpg[/img]

We've added hidden places to the game, and to find them, the main character has a magic candle. The candle changes color if there is a secret passage or treasure nearby.

[previewyoutube=U0mc30RHPbk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Development news: high speed mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38143999/40a4ec810d8b1ad73c497b8ca1fe99b76b279148.png[/img]
Having listened to the opinion of our users, we added a button to the game that includes an increased speed mode. In this mode, the character's movement speed is doubled.

Some of the mansion's interiors have also been redesigned to better suit the Victorian era.

Updated screenshots of the game.

[previewyoutube=TtgaVRNCBnU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Development news: revived armor
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38143999/ea5391a502bed2ae87487c42186ff3cbc1f29cd0.gif[/img]
Sometimes it is difficult to fall asleep at night in an English estate. Fearful sounds are heard in the dark corridors. If you need to go somewhere at night, you can unexpectedly stumble upon revived and fighting knights.

notes.title: Development news: the grave bell
notes.content: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38143999/0d2b12f7ac03b0ac8853ab7ba8df617dcb70e0aa.gif[/img]There were safe coffins in Victorian England: if you were buried somewhat prematurely and you wake up in a grave, then just ring the grave bell! Well, if you become a ghost, you can also ring the bell, why not?

notes.title: Development news: The ghost of the greedy bride
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38143999/16badfbf2ec9c7d5495b70f17ef2c86a59ed87d7.gif[/img]
A new character has appeared in the darkness of the dungeon - the ghost of the greedy bride.

notes.title: Development news: night cemetery
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38143999/a11b343153d5ae1fdff196ef485fe5afe3703206.gif[/img]

What could be better than a night walk in a cemetery in good old England, especially if you are a ghost?

Artificial intelligence has been added to the cat. Now it follows the main character.
